summary: Abuhamdieh explicitly rejected AIPAC-aligned money for his Berkeley City Council campaign in September 2026, stating he has not taken and will not take such funds. CAIR Action endorsed him in the general election, and Vote for Peace rated him an Ally—both organizations that assess candidates on Gaza positions and war-lobby funding. BAMC Action also supported his general-election bid.
